name: AWS Elastic Load Balancing Metrics
description: The Sumo Logic App for AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) Metrics lets you analyze the CloudWatch ELB metrics for the Application Load Balancer (ALB), and the Classic Load Balancer (CLB). The App provides preconfigured searches and dashboards that allow you to monitor the metrics healthy hosts, unhealthy hosts, HTTP backend codes, latency, requests, and more.
